title: Crowd Simulation with Varied Animation Cycles
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that implements a crowd simulation with varied animation cycles using the Duck.glb model.

## Scene Setup
- Use a perspective camera at position (0, 12, 20) looking at the origin.
- Add a large ground plane (60x60) with a muted green color (#556B2F) at y=0.
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.5) and a directional light at (10, 15, 10) with intensity 0.8 and shadow mapping enabled.
- Sky background color: #87CEEB.

## Crowd System
- Load Duck.glb using GLTFLoader from the Three.js examples CDN.
- Once loaded, clone the duck model to create a crowd of 20 duck agents arranged in a 5x4 grid with spacing of 4 units, centered on the origin.
- Each agent must have:
  - A unique index (0-19).
  - A random scale between 0.8 and 1.2 (uniform across x/y/z).
  - A random base color tint applied to all meshes (pick from: red #FF4444, blue #4444FF, green #44FF44, yellow #FFFF44, orange #FF8844 — assign randomly per agent).
  - An animation phase: one of 'idle', 'walk', 'bounce'. Assign cyclically: agent index % 3 === 0 -> 'idle', % 3 === 1 -> 'walk', % 3 === 2 -> 'bounce'.
  - idle: gentle sinusoidal Y-axis rotation oscillation (amplitude ±15 degrees, period 2s + random offset 0-1s).
  - walk: agent moves forward along its facing direction at speed 1.0 unit/s, with a sinusoidal vertical bob of amplitude 0.15 units at 4Hz. When reaching 25 units from origin, reverse direction (rotate 180°).
  - bounce: agent hops in place with sinusoidal vertical displacement, amplitude 1.0 unit, frequency 1.5Hz.

## Animation Speed Control
- Add a global animation speed multiplier starting at 1.0.
- Pressing 'ArrowUp' increases speed by 0.25 (max 3.0).
- Pressing 'ArrowDown' decreases speed by 0.25 (min 0.25).
- Pressing 'Space' toggles pause (speed becomes 0, pressing again restores previous speed).

## Agent Selection
- Implement raycasting on click. When a duck agent is clicked:
  - Highlight it with an emissive glow (emissive color #FFAA00, emissive intensity 0.6).
  - Deselect any previously selected agent (remove emissive).
  - Store the selected agent index.
- Pressing 'C' on keyboard cycles the selected agent's animation phase: idle->walk->walk->bounce->bounce->idle (i.e., advance to next phase cyclically among the three).

## Formation Toggle
- Add an HTML button with id='formationBtn' labeled 'Toggle Formation'.
- Clicking it toggles between 'grid' and 'circle' formation.
  - Grid: 5x4 grid with 4-unit spacing centered at origin (the initial layout).
  - Circle: all 20 agents arranged in a circle of radius 10 around the origin, evenly spaced, facing outward.
- When toggled, agents smoothly lerp to their new target positions over 2 seconds. During transition, agents keep their animation cycles running.

## Statistics HUD
- Add a DOM overlay div with id='statsHUD' at top-left showing:
  - Total agents count.
  - Counts per phase: idle, walk, bounce.
  - Current speed multiplier (1 decimal).
  - Current formation type.
  - Selected agent index or 'None'.

## State Management
- Expose window.__3D_STATE__ updated every frame with:
  - agentCount: number (total agents)
  - agents: array of objects {index, phase, position: {x,y,z}, scale, colorHex, distanceFromOrigin}
  - speedMultiplier: number
  - paused: boolean
  - selectedAgentIndex: number or -1
  - formation: 'grid' | 'circle'
  - formationTransitioning: boolean
  - phaseCounts: {idle: number, walk: number, bounce: number}
  - elapsedTime: number (seconds since start, respecting pause)
  - frameCount: number

Ensure all animations use delta-time multiplied by the speed multiplier. The scene must be fully functional in a single HTML file with no external dependencies beyond CDN Three.js and GLTFLoader.
physics_constraints: Agents must remain within 25 units of origin (walk agents reverse at boundary). Vertical positions must be non-negative (ground plane at y=0, bounce/bob only adds positive displacement from base). All position values must be NaN-free. Phase counts must always sum to agentCount. Speed multiplier must stay in [0.25, 3.0] range (or 0 when paused).
